Demi Lovato is about to make all your manicure dreams come true. Her collaboration with The New Black is an obvious (and awesome) next step for the beauty trendsetter and nail art fanatic. She’s constantly rocking bold styles (hello, bright blue hair!), which means that, come November when her collection hits Ulta shelves, you will be too.

So what’s in store? There are large and small kits available with five and three bottles respectively, and each set is packed with both polishes and fun extras like glitter, beads, and studs. So making custom creations, whether they’re sweet and sparkly or dark and spiky, is super simple and seriously fun! November feels like forever away, but trust us: Glam fingertips like these are worth the wait.
